preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call callget() function
Victim address must have some BOND token balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function to transfer tokens from any victim address to your own address. This function bypasses standard ERC20 allowance checks and can transfer tokens without approval due to inconsistent decimal handling between the contract's 18 decimals and potential external token interactions. The owner can directly steal tokens from any holder.
